name: ntr_db_onc_total_payout
xsql:
SELECT 
    Coalesce(v_total_qtr_personal_target, '0.00') AS total_qtr_personal_target,
    Coalesce(v_onc_payout_val, '0.00') AS onc_total_payout,
    Coalesce(v_onc_payout_pct, '0.00') AS onc_payout_percentage_of_budget
FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        -- 1. Format the Approved Budget for ONC
        FormatNumber(budget.total_qtr_personal_target, '#,##0.00') AS v_total_qtr_personal_target,
        
        -- 2. Format the Total Payout for ONC
        FormatNumber(payout.onc_payout, '#,##0.00') AS v_onc_payout_val,
        
        -- 3. Calculate Payout Percentage relative to the Budget
        Round(
            (payout.onc_payout * 100.0) / 
            CASE WHEN budget.total_qtr_personal_target = 0 THEN 1 ELSE budget.total_qtr_personal_target END, 
            2
        ) AS v_onc_payout_pct
    FROM (
        -- SUBQUERY A Calculates Budget Metrics
        SELECT SUM(pa_active.personal_target / 4.0) AS total_qtr_personal_target
        FROM xactly.xc_period per
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_input 
            ON pa_input.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_paticipant_title_mapping pta
            ON pa_input.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN $framework.NATERA_TITLE_CATEGORY_MAPPING m 
            ON pta.title_name = m.title
            AND m.category = 'ONC'
   /*   INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
      on pa_input.participant_id = ppa.participant_id
      INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
			on ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
      		and :v_qtr_start_date between pos.effective_start_date and pos.effective_end_date
              INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON pos.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id*/
        INNER JOIN xactly.xc_participant pa_active 
            ON pa_input.employee_id = pa_active.employee_id
            AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pa_active.effective_start_date AS DATE)
            AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pa_active.effective_end_date AS DATE)
        WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
      --AND (:p_region = 'ALL' or pos_reg.region in (:p_region))
    ) budget
    INNER JOIN (
        -- SUBQUERY B Calculates Payout Metrics
        SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS onc_payout
        FROM xactly.xc_payment p
        INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_paticipant_title_mapping pta
        ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
        INNER JOIN $framework.ntr_db_get_position_region_mapping pos_reg ON p.position_id = pos_reg.master_position_id
        INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
            ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
            AND pta.title_name = m.title
            AND m.category = 'ONC'
        WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
          AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
          AND (:p_region = 'ALL' or pos_reg.region in (:p_region))
    ) payout ON 1=1  -- Safe, universal alternative to CROSS JOIN
) AggData ON 1=1
